abstract: Run LLMs on Modal serverless GPUs: deploy a vLLM Server with @app.server, create managed Shared or Dedicated Endpoints, secure them with proxy auth tokens, cache weights in Volumes, control autoscaling and spend, connect to LiteLLM and OpenAI-compatible clients, and tear everything down. Covers the modal 1.6.1 CLI and Python SDK, GPU choices, cold starts, limits and a symptom-to-fix table for 401, 403, 429 and 503.
